title: Consistency Beats Intensity | A Discipline Short Film
lines: He used to go all in for three days, then disappear.
Intensity burns bright, and burns out.
Consistency is quieter. It just shows up.
Thirty minutes a day beats a ten-hour sprint once a month.
Not heroic. Not exciting. Just daily.
And that is exactly why it works.
Small, repeated actions build an unstoppable life.
